I am a woman with no schooling, and this small maize plot is close to my house. I have some land in other places too, but this one I tend myself. I have no husband to bring cash easily, so I must be careful. Last year I put a little DAP at planting because the cooperative gave it on credit, and the maize came up well, so I will do the same this year if the cooperative brings it in time. I do not have money for urea top-dressing, so I will only use what little DAP I can get, and I will carry manure from my few animals to help the soil. I keep my own seed from last year's harvest — improved seed costs too much and the agro-dealer is far. I weed with my own hands and my children help; I cannot pay people for this small plot.
